name: fade-ramp
description: The perceptual edge ramp every fade paints or masks with: a Gaussian penumbra (the cumulative normal, mean 0.55, sigma 0.22 of the depth) sampled at seventeen stops, so there is no corner at either end for the eye to read as a stripe, with a second table for dark grounds that leaves the same perceptual fraction of ink visible (light ink under a dark veil stays visible longer at equal alpha; the correction is the polarity's and agrees to ±0.015 across role pairs). paintRamp(direction, ground) builds the painted gradient, switching per stop with light-dark(); maskRamp(direction, depth) builds its complement for mask-image. The tables ship as numbers; fade-ramp.test.ts re-derives them from the curve and the OKLab model.
